purpose: Transactional application service for category configuration admin mutations, archive operations, permanent delete operations, and KV refresh.
businessRules: Category configuration is saree-focused and must stay saree-only.
Each write delegates persistence to AdminCategoryRepository and refreshes the public category aggregate through CategoryConfigService.
List reads reuse the public category service so admin and storefront see the same active graph.
Permanent delete operations are explicit methods invoked by reviewer-approved DELETE change requests.
